notes: No more repeated Git sign-in windows: BRIX checks quietly before every background fetch or push and only opens a sign-in when you click Sign in (one at a time across windows). Simpler account line: GitHub account with source tag, One-time sign-in needed, or cannot access this repo, with Details for all logins. Account order: your choice, then GitHub Desktop, then Git, then the editor. Names only, no tokens are read.
